root.command: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'ImportCollectShippingKeywords') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl ADD ImportCollectShippingKeywords NVARCHAR(200) NULL; END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl', N'ImportCollectShippingKeywords') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl WHERE SettingsID = 1 AND ImportCollectShippingKeywords IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ImportCollectShippingKeywords)) <> N'') BEGIN UPDATE dbo.WooCommerceSettingsTbl SET ImportCollectShippingKeywords = N'collect,buiten' WHERE SettingsID = 1; END
